# Resume bullets: JournalPulse

Three bullets for a resume or portfolio page. The numbers are filled in by
`scripts/resume_numbers.py --write` from generated evidence, and `make check-l5-docs` fails if
they drift from it. Edit the wording freely in the script's template; do not type numbers here.

<!-- bullets:begin (generated by scripts/resume_numbers.py; do not edit) -->
- Built a privacy-first journaling web app with an optional AI companion (FastAPI, PostgreSQL row-level security, signed writes, Next.js), covered by 1,436 backend tests at 92% branch coverage and 238 frontend tests, with README figures regenerated and checked in CI.
- Put a safety and consent gate in front of every model call (29 of 34 development cases pass, reported as not held out) and built an offline evaluation that recomputes a 60-scenario model-graded benchmark (8 wins, 5 losses, 7 ties; 95% interval -0.13 to 0.83); held the release when one critical case was uncertain.
- Made the service reproducible and operable: one command stands up and verifies a full environment (15 migrations, 7 database verifiers, a browser demo journey) in 53 s, and a database-outage drill showed writes refused with HTTP 503, 1 entry stored after the retry, and readiness restored 16 s after recovery.

Sources: `docs/evaluations/portfolio/results.json`, `outputs/onboarding/first-run/REPORT.md`, `outputs/incident-drill/2026-11-18.json`.
